title: ISO 15552:2018 — Pneumatic fluid power — Cylinders with detachable mountings, 1 000 kPa (10 bar) series, bores from 32 mm to 320 mm — Basic, mounting and accessories dimensions
locator: Official abstract: metric series for basic, mounting and accessory dimensions intended to support interchangeability for single/double rod pneumatic cylinders with detachable mountings in its stated pressure and bore scope.
notes: Dimensional interface standard only; it does not establish universal force, speed, leakage, cushioning, friction, life or all sensor/accessory interchangeability. Confirm full configuration and manufacturer data.
